title: DialogueQuestEditor
description: 🗨️ Build RPG-ready NPC dialogue + questlines in minutes with a visual in-game editor, branching choices, and per-player progression memory.
body:
# 🗨️ DialogueQuestEditor

Create story-rich NPC interactions **directly in-game** without complicated scripting.

## 🚀 Why Server Owners Install It
- Fast visual workflow for creating dialogue trees
- Branching choices that make quests feel alive
- Per-player memory so story progression actually matters
- Clean JSON persistence for backups and portability

## 🎮 Player Experience
- Meaningful NPC conversations with multiple response paths
- Quest outcomes tied to player decisions
- Better immersion for RPG, SMP, kingdoms, and lore servers

## ✨ Core Features
- Visual GUI editor for dialogue nodes and links
- Up to 4 player choices per node
- NPC right-click trigger support
- Quest reward integration in dialogue flow
- Persistent data in `plugins/DialogueQuestEditor/dialogues/`

## ⚙️ Quick Start
1. Use `/dialogue create <npcName>`
2. Add nodes, player responses, and links
3. Set rewards and progression
4. Save and test in-game instantly

## ✅ Compatibility
- Paper / Spigot ecosystem
- Java 17+
- Lightweight runtime footprint

If you want **deeper roleplay and better retention**, DialogueQuestEditor gives your world real narrative depth.
